search_data.interpretation: source URL metadata fields are not emitted into the catalog schema; exact candidate frontmatter lines remain in byte-identical public Markdown; search bodies are derived from article bodies after frontmatter removal; matches in body are original body content, not catalog metadata.

runtime_static_review.beforeEach_observation: Pinned wiki.js is byte-identical in build. Its beforeEach resets in-memory metadata; rewrites relative Markdown links only on homepage routes / and /README, skips scheme/absolute/hash/already-prefixed targets, then parses simple scalar frontmatter and returns markdown after frontmatter. No source file is written. This transformation changes rendered in-memory text for homepage relative links and removes simple scalar frontmatter from rendered Markdown; parsing trims/unquotes values for display, but raw generated Markdown remains byte-identical. wiki-search-worker builds excerpts by slicing body text; excerpt presentation may cut a URL, while stored article/search-body data is not changed.
